analyst.summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals just completed India's biggest recent pharma buyout, folding in JB Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals to build a much larger company with added international and contract-manufacturing capability. The underlying India business is genuinely strong, growing faster than the industry on its chronic-disease drug portfolio, and the company has a credible three-year plan to pay down the debt taken on for the deal. But the stock trades near its all-time high at roughly 74-77 times trailing earnings - a rich price even for a high-quality business - and most of the earnings growth priced in over the next two years comes from folding in a full year of the acquired company's numbers rather than the underlying business simply growing faster. With debt elevated, the acquisition still in its early integration innings, one plant's regulatory status not fully confirmed as clean, and ongoing patent litigation around its new diabetes-drug franchise, we do not see enough cushion in the price to recommend holding it here - our call is Sell.
